description_en: Assigns access permissions on an account in your resource directory to a user or a group by using an access configuration
description_zh: 为RD账号设置允许访问的用户或用户组，以及对应的访问权限（访问配置）
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso create-access-assignment --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --principal-type User --principal-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccessAssignment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the task object. Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory
parameters.help_zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task object
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the CloudSSO identity. Valid values:

- User

- Group
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份类型。取值：

- User：用户。
- Group：用户组
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CloudSSO identity.

- If you set `PrincipalType` to `User`, set `PrincipalId` to the ID of the CloudSSO user.

- If you set `PrincipalType` to `Group`, set `PrincipalId` to the ID of the CloudSSO group
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份ID。具体如下：

- 当`PrincipalType`为`User`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户ID。
- 当`PrincipalType`为`Group`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户组ID
parameters.name: principal_id
